CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. The speed of the music
   C. Only the volume
   D. Only the costume

2. Best practice when working on Storytelling and Animation: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Storytelling and Animation.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Storytelling and Animation.
   C. Damage equipment used for Storytelling and Animation.
   D. Practise Storytelling and Animation with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Remove the need for rules

4. Best practice when working on Javelin and Sculpture: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Javelin and Sculpture.
   B. Practise Javelin and Sculpture with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

   D. Disrupt classmates during Javelin and Sculpture.

7. Best practice when working on Handball: (1 mark)

   D. Refuse all feedback on Handball.

8. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   D. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   C. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Melody.

10. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)

   B. Refuse all feedback on Drawing and Painting.
   C. Damage equipment used for Drawing and Painting.

11. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

12. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Green, orange, and purple

13. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   B. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

14. Best practice when working on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Football and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
